name: Processor_D_6Q_Diamond_Core
description: Processor D (Diamond-Coupled Co-Design). 4-qubit computational core {0, 1, 2, 3} with complete graph connectivity K_4 (6 native CX edges) plus 2 flag/readout ancillae {4, 5}. Purpose-engineered to eliminate SWAP bottlenecks for 4-qubit ZZFeatureMap(entanglement='full').
optimal_4q_subgraph_description: Complete 4-qubit K_4 computational core {0, 1, 2, 3}. Every pair of logical qubits in ZZFeatureMap has a direct native physical edge, guaranteeing strictly 0 SWAP overhead.

noise_params.description: Frozen QFF 2026 synthetic noise: 1Q depolarizing p=0.001 on [rz,sx,x], 2Q depolarizing p=0.005 on [cx], symmetric readout error p=0.01 on all qubits.
